terbaru.judul: AI Agent for Education: von Neumann Multi-Agent System Framework
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper centers on the multi-Agent system in education and proposes the von Neumann multi-Agent system framework.

terbaru.judul: Swarm Intelligence in Collision-free Formation Control for Multi-UAV Systems with 3D Obstacle Avoidance Maneuvers
terbaru.pelajaran: Inspired by the collective behavior of tilapia fish and pigeon, the presented framework in this study uses a centralized controller for the optimal formation control/recovery, which is defined by probabilistic Lloyd's algorithm, while it uses a distributed controller for the intervehicle collision and obstacle avoidance.

terbaru.judul: Large-scale Group Brainstorming using Conversational Swarm Intelligence (CSI) versus Traditional Chat
terbaru.pelajaran: Conversational Swarm Intelligence (CSI) is an AI-facilitated method for enabling real-time conversational deliberations and prioritizations among networked human groups of potentially unlimited size.

terbaru.pelajaran: In the autonomous vehicle and self-driving paradigm, cooperative perception or exchanging sensor information among vehicles over wireless communication has added a new dimension.

terbaru.judul: Swarm Intelligence-Driven Client Selection for Federated Learning in Cybersecurity applications
terbaru.pelajaran: This study addresses a critical gap in the literature regarding the use of Swarm Intelligence Optimization (SI) algorithms for client selection in Federated Learning (FL), with a focus on cybersecurity applications.
